candidate_changes.feature: Backup-QB games where the model disagrees with the close by ≥3
candidate_changes.evidence: W9 MIN, W10 NYG, W10 BAL: model ≥5 more bullish than the close on the backup team, 0/3. W11 flipped direction: model ≥3 more bearish than the close on the backup team (PHI Milton gap −6.9, NYG McCarthy −3.4, BAL Brissett +4.6) and all three backups covered (PHI, NYG won outright). Model ATS 0/6 in these games, either direction. The market is pricing backup QBs better than the rating plus our QB term. W11 backup sides 3/4 vs close (PHI, NYG, BAL yes; MIN no); W3–W11 13/27.
candidate_changes.confirm_if: Replay shows deferring to the close (or PASS) when |gap|≥3 with a QB1 OUT/IR beats the live line by ≥0.5/game on the 27-game set
candidate_changes.falsify_if: next 3 such games go the model’s way

candidate_changes.bucket: Decrease candidate → Sandmoney test at 0.5× (no live change)
candidate_changes.evidence: W11 helped 4/13 live (7.69 with vs 7.03 without); second straight week under 50% (W10 6/13), which meets the W10 falsify rule for "earns its keep". Pool W2–W11 helped 70/145 (48%); 10.232 with vs 10.180 without. Blind W11 at 0.5× (fit on W2–W10 prefers 0.5× by a hair, 10.468 vs 10.478): 7.28 vs 7.69. Big terms ≥1.5 helped 18/42. W11 big misses: BAL@CAR +2.81 (BAL IR QB + IDL/CB cluster) hurt 2.81; PIT@PHI −2.65 (PHI Hurts IR 0.77 + LB/WR) hurt 2.65.
candidate_changes.confirm_if: Sandmoney 2021–25 replay or W12–W13 blind shows 0.5× ≤ live by ≥0.1/game

candidate_changes.evidence: W11 auto hit the 1.5 cap (Murray lost his Madden row in the 11-17 rebuild) and a manual set it to 0.3 because the market had priced Cousins. MIN lost by 25 in Mexico City, so the 1.5 auto would have cut error by ~1.2. The floor rule and the Cousins-is-fine manual pull in opposite directions; this needs one written rule, not game-by-game manuals.
